title: ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35804, October 1, 2025>
title_original: 환경교육의 활성화 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35804, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, with respect to Presidential Decrees amended under Article 6 of the Addenda that have been promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived, the provisions amending such Presidential Decrees shall enter into force on the enforcement dates of the respective Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to other statutes and regulations) Paragraphs (1) through (70) Omitted.
(71) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education is partially amended as follows:
In Article 2(1), Article 3(3), Article 4(2)2, Article 4(3), the introductory part of Article 16(1), the introductory part of Article 16(2), Article 16(3) and (4), Article 18(2) through (5), Article 19, Article 20(1)3, Article 20(2) and (3), the introductory part of Article 21(1), the introductory part of Article 21(2), and Article 22, "Minister of Environment" is replaced in each instance with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Article 4(2)1, "Ministry of Women and Family" is replaced with "Ministry of Gender Equality and Family".

In Article 4(7), "Vice Minister of Environment" is replaced with "Vice Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment (meaning a Vice Minister designated by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment)".

In Article 9(2), "Ministry of Environment" is replaced with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment"; in the introductory part of Article 16(2), "Ministry of Environment and" is replaced with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and"; in Articles 16(4) and 18(4), "Ministry of Environment or" is replaced in each instance with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment or"; and in Article 19, "of the Ministry of Environment" is replaced with "of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".

In Note 2 to Appendix 1, "Minister of Environment" is replaced with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

Paragraphs (72) through (80) Omitted.
